title: one-change changelog entry (omnimarket#3002)
prompt:
Summarize the merged change below in at most two sentences for a changelog: what changed, then why. Name the pull request number exactly as written (#NNNN). Use only facts stated in the change text. Also name the ticket OMN-19830.

--- change 1 (repo omnimarket, pull request #3002) ---
feat(OMN-19830): classify_head_checks classifier reproduces the labelled check-run corpus, with run attempts on the verdict (#3002)
The triage compute's classify_head_checks operation now classifies one PR
head's check facts into its verdict. The newest copy of each check name
decides it; blocking checks are the required contexts plus what a red
CI Summary names; each red gets its reason code from the merge-check
classifier and one class (change control, timed out, runner, cancelled,
product); the verdict follows the corpus manifest's precedence. A red
nothing recognises goes to an agent and is never re-run.

The verdict carries the run attempt of each blocking result it read
(revision 1, F7), and change_control_open stays in the corpus (R3).

The corpus gains four real heads for the two verdicts 2026-09-26 lacked:
timed_out (omnimarket#2564, 2026-09-15) and runner_infra (omnibase_infra
#4049, #4068, #4115, 2026-09-24/25), with the search recorded in the
manifest. The merge-check classifier learns that an image pre-pull step is
the runner's environment.

Respond with the answer only. Do not show your reasoning, do not narrate your steps, and do not preface the answer with anything.
